$comment: Market-sweep phase. The ONLY phase with network reach, and only through the two Exa tools declared by the content-radar runtime. EXA_API_KEY must be present in the daemon process environment; keep the value out of sandbox.env. Note: exa_search/exa_contents are parent-scope host tools, so sandbox.network.allowedHosts does not constrain them — the tool implementation pins the origin. See examples/content-radar-runtime/README.md.
